title: Busta Rhymes Receives His Flowers From P.M. Dawn's K.R.O.K
htmlContent:
On Wednesday evening Busta Rhymes was on Twitter Space with The H.U.S.L. Founder, and C.E.O. Varun Bajaj talked about their N.F.T. Collection partnership when P.M. Dawn's K.R.O.K came on stage to ask him a question about Cryptocurrency.

Busta was asked about the possibility of Ethereum flipping Bitcoin and his thoughts on it?

" I am exactly trying to understand the space. So, I don't have many thoughts on the space entirely yet, but I will say this. I'm going to make sure I am informed when it's time to celebrate that flip happens. We are celebrating together out this mother f***, said Rhymes.

Also, during their exchange, K.R.O.K. gave Busta Rhymes his flowers and thanked him for clearing a sample for his group P.M. Dawn.

"While the roses are still good, I want to say I appreciate you for what you did for my group, said K.R.O.K.

Busta replied, " I appreciate y'all did for what y'all did for me too. F*** you talking about?"

K.R.O.K.: We appreciate you clearing that sample for the 'Oh My God' joint you feel me?

Busta: It's all good.

After the Twitter Space ended, the fans were calling for both individuals to collaborate an NFT after K.R.O.K said that the group had some plans for N.F.T.'s soon and some new music.

Make sure you check out Busta Rhymes Dragon NFT Dragon Collection collaboration with The HUSL dropping on Thursday afternoon.
